cohort: Women with a history of spontaneous preterm birth (N=428) from the Genomic and Proteomic Network for Preterm Birth Research Longitudinal Cohort Study (GPN-PBR LS)
finding: A clinical phenotyping tool incorporating maternal demographic and clinical characteristics, as well as obstetric history, effectively identified risk factors for recurrent preterm birth.
birth_weight: Previous birth weight was considered as an exposure
